target.name: Amazon Heat Dome to Drought & Fire

story_scenes.title: Moist Rainforest Canopy
story_scenes.narration: Water-rich Amazon leaves scatter radar waves strongly (-7.8 dB) with vibrant greenness (0.82 NDVI).
story_scenes.why_these_layers: Establish normal moisture and canopy density before drought ridge strengthens.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Wet leaves reflect radar energy reliably across intact rainforest.

causal_chain.explanation: Water-filled leaves increase radar dielectric backscatter.

story_scenes.title: Drought Desiccation Rising
story_scenes.narration: Dry easterly air stalls rain (<0.5 mm/hr) and pushes surface temperatures to +38°C, drying soils and forest fuel.
story_scenes.why_these_layers: Heat + wind detect rising drought danger while greenness still appears deceptively healthy.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Optical greenness barely reacts yet even though tree transpiration is crashing.

causal_chain.explanation: Blocked ocean moisture forces solar energy directly into sensible canopy heat.

story_scenes.title: 3-Week Early Warning & Drying Trap
story_scenes.narration: Radar drops 4.5 dB as canopy water drains weeks before leaves turn brown. Thermal heat proves this is drought stress, not clear-cut logging.
story_scenes.why_these_layers: Combining Radar + Heat warns of fire danger 3 weeks early and separates drying from logging.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Dielectric Drying Illusion flagged: standing dry trees drop backscatter like felled trees.

causal_chain.explanation: Leaf water loss precedes visible brown leaf chlorophyll breakdown by 2–3 weeks.

story_scenes.title: Fire Erupts Beneath Dense Smoke
story_scenes.narration: Understory fires race through dried margins. Thick grey smoke blinds sunlight cameras while Heat & Radar pierce the plume cleanly.
story_scenes.why_these_layers: MODIS Thermal + SAR Radar track active combustion fronts under opaque aerosol clouds.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Cloud/Smoke Blanking triggers on optical view.

causal_chain.explanation: Sustained +39°C heat converts green rainforest into ignitable surface fuel.

story_scenes.title: Charred Burn Scar & Night Embers
story_scenes.narration: As smoke clears, NDVI crashes to 0.16 over burned blocks while NASA Black Marble catches smoldering nighttime hotspots.
story_scenes.why_these_layers: Post-fire Optical greenness crash + Black Marble fireglow verify true burned acreage.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Structural canopy destruction creates a permanent SAR loss signature.

causal_chain.explanation: Charred ash replaces forest structure while glowing fire lines appear in nightlights.

illusion_summary: Extreme forest drying drops radar volume scattering by -4.5 dB even when trees are still standing, tricking naive SAR classifiers into false deforestation alarms unless checked against thermal heat stress.
causal_summary: Moisture Block & Subsidence Ridge -> +39°C Surface Heat & Dry Easterlies -> Radar Canopy Moisture Drop (-4.5 dB, 21 days early) -> Optical Smoke Blindness -> Wildfire & Burn Scar.

geo_features.label: Dry Subsidence Easterly Flow
geo_features.detail: Moisture-starved winds dry canopy litter across the lower Rio Negro watershed.

geo_features.label: ECOSTRESS Heat Stress Dome (+39.2°C)
geo_features.detail: Evaporative cooling fails as stomata close under acute soil water deficit.

geo_features.label: Understory Wildfire Front & Burn Scar
geo_features.detail: Detected through dense biomass smoke using MODIS thermal + Sentinel-1 coherence.
